question: Can an authoritative professional inspection determination trigger a legal consequence under unchanged law without being represented as a metric, set state or textual mutation?

authoritative_finding.authority_context: Port State Control authority in Greece / Paris MoU inspection system

finding.statement: Thirteen deficiencies were found and all thirteen were grounds for detention.

governing_rule.effect: Where deficiencies are clearly hazardous to safety, health or the environment, the competent port-State authority shall ensure detention or stoppage; inspectors apply Annex X detention criteria.

later_access_refusal.statement: The Paris MoU notice also records that this was the ship's third detention within 36 months and announced a three-month refusal of access after departure.

shared_shape: authoritative categorical determination about a concrete subject
legal consequence is conditioned on the determination
categorical truth is not scalar metric truth
categorical truth is not membership in an authoritative dynamic set

differences.hpai: scientific disease confirmation about a location, followed by a separate spatial legal derivation
differences.bahar: professional inspection determination about a ship, followed by detention without a spatial derivation

forbidden_inferences: BAHAR's inspection finding is a textual mutation of Directive 2009/16/EC.
The count of 13 deficiencies makes the finding a metric-triggered case; the legally material fact is the authoritative determination that the deficiencies were grounds for detention.
A ship becomes a member of a dynamic legal set merely because it is detained.
The Authoritative Finding contract should own refusal-of-access history or a generic enforcement lifecycle.
The Paris MoU publication is treated as EU legislation; it is official inspection-system evidence supporting the concrete determination and outcome.

official_sources.locator: detained 18 July 2026; 13 deficiencies; all grounds for detention
